notes.title: WDC World Oceans Day Charity Sale 🐬
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43757573/2d214bc970c53cf8782c55c2ca70f2f527d8c607.png[/img] 

[h1]We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day![/h1] 

[h3]The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10am PDT 2023, and you can save a fin-tastic [b]50% off [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/765810/Mars_Horizon/]Mars Horizon 1[/url][/b] and[b] 90% off [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/370870/Dark_Future_Blood_Red_States/]Dark Future: Blood Red States[/url][/b]. We will also donate 20% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* [/h3] 

[h3][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2281620/Mars_Horizon_2_The_Search_for_Life/]Mars Horizon 2: The Search for Life[/url][/b] is also included in this event as an upcoming title, make sure you wishlist and follow![/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/e16eb797ea21a8804a92921c56bbacb66269a1f9.jpg[/img] [i]Photo credit: Shutterstock[/i]

[h2]WDC, Whale and Dolphin conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins.[/h2] 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.  

Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by:  

[list] [*] Stopping cruelty from deliberate harms such as whaling and captivity.  
[*] Creating safe seas, free from the threat of pollution, collisions with vessels and accidental entanglement in fishing gear.  
[*] Winning recognition of whales and dolphins as sentient, socially complex beings, and our allies in the fight against climate and nature breakdown.  
[*] Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. They have suffered from terrible harm - deliberate and accidental - and their homes and populations are under threat. But it's not too late.   
[*] Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused.   [/list] 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [url=https://whales.org/ ]https://whales.org/ [/url] 

You can find many other amazing games in the sale here: [url=https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale23]https://bit.ly/OceansDaySteamSale23[/url]   

[h3]Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC! 🐳[/h3] 

*20% of our net developer revenue from this sale will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. Whale and Dolphin Conservation is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705)

notes.title: Patch Notes: 28th May 2020, Mytholmroyd
notes.content:
Hello all,

This update adds new Player Vehicle Skins with which to look extra stylish while dealing death to your fellow road users. If you’ve unlocked a character that uses the corresponding vehicle then you can assign that skin regardless of whether you’ve completed their Season.

If you missed some of our previous updates, click the links below to see what’s been added since launch;

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/3557193237111858940/]Duffield[/url] (20th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026028761300/]Mugginton[/url] (22nd May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026051157245/]Coxbench[/url] (28th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1642039362993277683/]Meenacladdy[/url] (7th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1643167006252949099/]Ballyhillin[/url] (25th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/]Suckley[/url] (11th November 2019)

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Added five new Player Vehicle Skins: True Fan (Interceptor Light), Omega (Civilian Vehicle), Go Fasta (T-Bird Thunder), Blocked (Interceptor Light), Hexed (Interceptor Medium).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed typo: rogue apostrophe on Tutorial.
- Fixed typo: the Guided Rockets now fire in a “salvo”.

Want to swap strategies or share road war stories? Fancy a peek at what the studio is up to next? Head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/K6mTVpS]our Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/]official website[/url].

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Our latest update is now live - plus competitions and podcasts!
notes.content:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/] The Suckley update [/url] focuses on improving visibility for achievement progress, introduces the ability to swap between vehicle skins, and brings with it bug fixes and some other minor improvements to the overall package.   [*]In-game achievements menu added. This handy update shows how close you are to reaching specific achievements. It’s accessible from the Main Menu and during combat when the game is paused.

  [*]Message box and Discord button added to Main Menu.
  [*]Moved version info about game to Options.

notes.title: Photo competition: What is it and the T&Cs
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/7feb3d7dc2ddca1ca0266f60cf58d883c782ca0b.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, 

Over these last few weeks we've been so impressed with all of your screenshots from the game that we thought... why not reward these excellent images!

To that end, we've decided to host a [b]Dark Future Photo Competition[/b] every month, with the winner taking home an awesome prize!

Below are all the details and information you:

[h1]Competition Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*] Check out the theme for the month (posted on the News and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/]Discussion Page[/url])
[*] Get into the game and get those screenshots (Need help with the screenshots? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1750167161]Check out this handy guide![/url])
[*] Submit the photos to the screenshots page on Steam. 
[*] Share the link by the closing date (date in the pinned post!)
[*] We'll pick the best one
[*] The winner gets that months Prize!
[/list]

[h1]Other bits[/h1]

[list]
[*] No more than three submissions (and by that we mean three links)
[*] Auroch Digtial will manage and administer the competition and any questions should be sent through to AurochMatt on Steam in the first instance
[/list]

Capiche? 

So what are you waiting for? The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1644290549108310268/]first competition is live now and you can submit your photos on the theme of [b]Explosions[/b] over on the Discussion Page[/url]

notes.title: Dark Future Post Launch Round-Up
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Was it only last week that Dark Future: Blood Red States came out? We hope you guys have been having an awesome time with it and causing as much mayhem and chaos as you can!

To do a mini-roundup of news for you:

[h1]Podcast[/h1]

The [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]latest episode of our podcast has gone live[/url]. This season has focused on Dark Future from its role in the car combat genre to the game you see before you.

This weeks episode is a special one though as we speak with James Swallow, one of the original writers in the Dark Future novels. The New York Times bestselling authour tells us more about his role in the books and in the game itself.

[url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]Take a listen now[/url]

[h1]Updates[/h1]

We've implemented two updates already to the game. The first is called [b]Duffield[/b] and includes the following changes:

notes.title: Price, release date and time
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In an update a few of you have been waiting for... we are happy to announce the price and the release time for [b]Dark Future: Blood Red States![/b]

[h1]Price[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26301211/23813975e12b7a6b0f9e7bb3617e4af5550c06f1.png[/img]

The game will normally be £19.99 ($24.99, €20.99), [b]however[/b], we will also be launching with a 25% discount making the game £14.99 ($19.99, €17.99) on release!

It won't be around forever though, so don't miss out!

[h1]Release Times[/h1]

We can also announce that the game will be coming to Steam at [b]16:00 (UK Time)[/b] on Thursday 16th May!

We've made a handy guide for all those outside of the UK for the release slots

A quick update to say that this time next week Dark Future is launching [b]NEXT WEEK[/b] (Thursday 16th May)

If you saw before we have been podcasting about car-combat and the history of Dark Future. Episode 2 came out today and in it, we talk all about the board game which this game is inspired by.

Have a [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/podcast/]listen on your podcast player of choice![/url]

[h1]Streamer help[/h1]

We are looking for people who [b]you[/b] think might be a good fit for Dark Future the game. Any recommendations drop them in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1651043320668001034/]conversation on our Discussion page[/url]. 

[h1]Discord[/h1]

As always, we have a few [url=https://discord.gg/YmdRt7h]Dark Future fans over on our Discord channel[/url] nattering away about the game, pop on over and join in!

[h1]Final bit[/h1]

We have an update tomorrow for you about [b]Trading Cards[/b] and [b]Badges [/b]and then one on Monday all around the [b]Achievements[/b] in the game!

[b]UPDATE[/b]: So after all the too and fro, we have had the confirmation that the keys are coming. The new plan is a release on Thursday 18th April at 17:00 (UK Time). [url=https://mailchi.mp/aurochdigital/beta-keys-coming] You can find more details on our update.[/url]

Do you want to get your hands on an early access beta build of Dark Future: Blood Red States? Well today is your lucky day!

We are looking for people to take part in a beta weekend of this upcoming title and it couldn't be easier to take part.

[list]

[*] [b]Step 1[/b]: [strike]Visit this link and add your email address to the system[/strike] [b]Sorry, now closed![/b]

[*] [b]Step 3[/b]: We'll send you an access code

[*] [b]Step 5[/b]: Step into Dark Future: Blood Red States
